2026-09-22 (SD mode, supersedes the fleet sequencing in the notes above): the intake court is ON MAIN via salvage ae3dee2d (+92e1ae78), but it is the pre-repair lineage. Remaining work, in order:
1. Port the 99602baa BundleAvailability/RequiredArtifact repair (availability separate from provenance; git diff 99602baa ae3dee2d -- embed-bench/src/*/scala/storymodel4s/bench/nfrd embed-bench/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/consumer/NfrdIntakePublicSuite.scala) and its fromProduct positive control onto main. 99602baa has no branch; pin a ref to it first (SD3).
2. Port the 7c7858f3 (branch codex-nfrd-receipt-v3) receipt binding: the checked Diagnostic origin root/reason and the non-disclosing artifact-reference digest go into contentChecksum (main renders the constant "origin=diagnostic" at intake.scala:511).
3. The three class anchors (NfrdBaseballSpec, VerifiedParticipant, NfrdBaseballReceipt) from the 2026-08-31 disposition.
Acceptance: each port carries a named mutation kill (remove the availability arm; drop origin from the checksum; drop the reference digest) that fails a named test while its sibling passes; embedBench tests + checkAll green on the exact SHA; external aggregate-only court rerun with receipts reproduced. Part 2 (diagnostic court) remains with bd-01M1DB6J4VFETMCFG096713DCY.
